decision_record.claim: The X4.5 implementation repairs 16 blocking findings from the Round 1 prepublication review of the X4.4 narrow boundary. The boundary is renamed from EmbeddedSafariExtensionWithCandidateArtifactManifestBoundary to SafariCompanionNativeDetectionBoundary to remove structural and manifest-service overclaims. The native contract module now returns a typed Pydantic model (SafariNativeProjection), wires build_environment detection and check_safari_extension_enabled() into the projection, uses fail-closed exception handling, documents enum state reachability, and is consumed by the M0 and Inference Studio projection builders.

alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: 'Embedded' overclaims structural guarantee not proven in all environments. 'CandidateArtifactManifest' overclaims manifest service responsibility that belongs to X4.4 narrow boundary artifacts. Prepublication Falsifier Contract prohibits boundary atoms that exceed proven capability.

alternative_rejected.option: Keep broad except Exception in merge functions
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Broad except Exception masks unexpected failures and makes fail-closed undetectable. Narrowing to ImportError/OSError/subprocess.CalledProcessError/subprocess.TimeoutExpired and adding logger.warning on unexpected exceptions makes fail-closed detectable.

alternative_rejected.option: Keep raw dict return from build_safari_native_projection
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Untyped dict prevents pyright validation on consumer side. Typed Pydantic model enables attribute access (.safari_companion_state) and schema validation.
